# Composed by hand from OpenSSL 3's s_client output format (no OpenSSL 3 command-line tool was available to capture from): at its default security level the client will not offer TLS 1.0, so it sends a protocol_version alert (7 bytes) and no ClientHello; the error-line prefix is replaced with 1000; session start times are replaced with 1900000000.
CONNECTED(00000003)
1000:error:0A0000BF:SSL routines:tls_setup_handshake:no protocols available:.../ssl/statem/statem_lib.c:104:
---
no peer certificate available
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---

Verification: OK
---

Secure Renegotiation IS NOT supported
No ALPN negotiated

    Cipher    : 0000
    Session-ID:

    Master-Key:
    PSK identity: None
    PSK identity hint: None
    SRP username: None
